threads.body: The Quarkus Gradle plugin now remains on 3.38.3 while the enforced Quarkus BOM is 3.39.0. This splits the build tooling (`quarkusBuild` and generated-source tasks) from the runtime/platform being exercised, so the smoke image does not consistently validate one Quarkus release and may hit unsupported model/augmentation differences. Align the plugin with the 3.39.0 platform (or keep both on 3.38.3).
